title: Matrix-free voxel elasticity on GPUs: artifact repository
description:
Artifact repository for "Matrix-free voxel elasticity on GPUs: a reproducible kernel and multigrid study across precisions and hardware" by Abderrazzak Nejeoui and Aissam Bekkari. Version v1.2 reorganizes the supporting-information sources (analysis/supplement_*.py, paper/supplement/, provenance/supplement/) and regenerates the supplement; numerical results are unchanged. It contains code, retained experimental protocols and records, analysis scripts, generated results, and the supporting-information supplement.

The documented CPU build regenerates numerical results, tables and figures from retained records. Saved-state verification coverage is session-specific; fresh GPU execution is a separate workflow. Historical experiment tags identify the original snapshots. The hypothesis registry documents declaration/execution chronology and its limits. No new GPU experiments were performed, and raw measurements and frozen protocols are unchanged. The manuscript text is not part of this repository.

Large raw-evidence archives remain available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22998404. Code is MIT-licensed; data and documentation are CC BY 4.0. Third-party material retains its own terms.
